autoreconf -i
./configure --enable-lib-only
make -j$(nproc) all

$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -Ilib/includes \
    fuzz/fuzz_target.cc -o $OUT/nghttp2_fuzzer \
    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE lib/.libs/libnghttp2.a

cp $SRC/*.options $OUT

zip -j $OUT/nghttp2_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip fuzz/corpus/*/*
